Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — it was helpful to map the three main integration points and your expected Q3 launch window. I’ve attached a short pricing deck and a working estimate that reflect the profile we discussed (hosted API for experiments + dedicated pools for production). Key assumptions are summarized on page 2 of the deck.

Quick highlights:
- Monthly baseline throughput: ~150M tokens (estimated for initial 5 services)
- Dedicated capacity: reserved G4 class with burst to hosted in two regions
- Estimated monthly range (conservative / typical): $25k — $42k

Attachments (stubs): pricing_deck_brightlane_v3.pdf (PDF, 7 pages); brightlane_estimate_v1.xlsx (Excel, 3 tabs)

If helpful I can walk through the deck and line-item assumptions in 15–20 minutes. Proposed slots: Tue 4/6 10:00am PT, Wed 4/7 2:00pm PT, Thu 4/8 9:30am PT. If none of those work, tell me a couple of times that do and I’ll make one of them happen.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm which deployment mode you want to pilot (hosted vs dedicated)
2) Share any procurement constraints (term, PO timing, examples of required security attestations)
3) Set a brief walkthrough so I can answer line-item questions with Marissa (ops) on the call

Thanks — I’ll be standing by for timing.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
